slides.texte_overlay:
unusual habits that quietly
pull people towards you

the proper goodbye

when you leave, say goodbye to everyone you talked to, not just your friends. people never forget the person who made a point of noticing them on the way out.

the slow nod

nod slowly while someone is talking to you. a gentle, unhurried nod says i'm really listening, and people keep talking to whoever makes them feel heard.

the unexpected story

always have one unexpected story ready to share at a table. a strange invention or an odd myth turns you into the person everyone wants to sit next to at dinner.
slides.texte_sophia:
the unexpected story

i never had anything to say in group chats. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a strange invention, and i always have a story people love.

slides.texte_overlay:
the follow up

bring up a small thing someone mentioned last time: a trip, an exam, a new job. remembering a detail is so rare that people feel instantly drawn to you.

the phone face down

put your phone face down and out of reach when you're with someone. real, undivided attention has become so rare that people notice it and feel it straight away.
